text:
Slack conversation with the website agent, 2026-09-30. Matt Barge clarifying MacKenzie Price's 2026-09-25 team-order decision, as relayed in the marketingsupport run note work-assets/apex-website-tickets/team-order-2026-09-30/RUN-NOTE-2.md (team-order sweep, second pass):

Matt Barge's clarification of MacKenzie Price's 2026-09-25 decision (Slack to the website agent, 2026-09-30): the intent is to show the people who are present and involved at that campus first. Dr. Tasha Arnold (Head of Schools, who appears on many campuses) goes LAST in the team section, after the Director of Admissions, the Dean of Parents (or Associate Dean), the head or lead guide, and every other campus-present card. The first pass today put her second or third; this pass moves her to the end.

Pages whose Head of School is a different person (Brownsville: Paige Fults) follow the same rule for that person only if they are not campus-present; Paige is Brownsville's own head of school, so Brownsville does not change in this pass.

The Director of Admissions and the Dean of Parents are not ranked against each other.
